name: social-post-preview
title: Social Post Preview
description: Renders a Post for Me social post as platform-accurate mock previews. Hand SocialPostPreview a social post and it applies the full configuration cascade (post ▸ platform ▸ account) to render one frame per targeted account, each dispatched to its platform×surface chrome in a phone device frame. Drop to the per-platform `<platform>-chrome` primitives to build your own.
